name: Chopper
description: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).
script:
# Chopper
# Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param c = Floor [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = softsquare; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Radio Voice
description: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).
script:
# Radio Voice
# AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).

param a = Center [500, 2200]
param b = Width [180, 900]
param c = Drive [1.2, 4.0]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)
stage2: y = bitcrush(y, 10)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.4

name: Vocal Comp
description: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.
script:
# Vocal Comp
# Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.

param a = Threshold [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.5, 10.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.005; release = 0.12
stage1: y = diode(x, c)

name: Sidechain Pump
description: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.
script:
# Sidechain Pump
# Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.

param a = Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Depth [0.4, 1.0]
param c = Floor [0.0, 0.35]
osc1: shape = sine; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (c + (1.0 - c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))

name: Dual Path Regen
description: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.
script:
# Dual Path Regen
# Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Regen [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Tone [1000, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.4)
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.55), c)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.35

name: Optical Leveler Comp
description: optical leveler: optical, program-dependent. Attack ~10 ms, release 0.5 s (50% then hang — we use 0.48). Comp ratio ~3:1. Peak Reduction + Gain. T4-cell smoothness, tube makeup.
script:
# Optical Leveler Comp
# optical leveler: optical, program-dependent. Attack ~10 ms, release 0.5 s (50% then hang — we use 0.48). Comp ratio ~3:1. Peak Reduction + Gain. T4-cell smoothness, tube makeup.

param a = PeakRed [-28.0, -6.0]
param b = Gain [0.7, 2.2]
param c = Limit [3.0, 12.0]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = c; attack = 0.01; release = 0.48; knee = 6; makeup = 2; hpf = 60
stage1: y = tube(x * b, 1.12)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 15000; resonance = 0.2

name: Radio Band Vocal
description: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
script:
# Radio Band Vocal
# AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Center [800, 2200]
param c = Width [400, 1400]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.3

name: Telephone Cup
description: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
script:
# Telephone Cup
# Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.

param a = Grit [0.8, 3.5]
param b = Low [280, 700]
param c = High [2200, 4200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.45
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4
stage1: y = diode(x, a)

name: Vocal Opto Soft
description: Softer than optical leveler stock. Low ratio, long release.
script:
# Vocal Opto Soft
# Softer than optical leveler stock. Low ratio, long release.

param a = Pull [12, 32]
param b = Release [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Makeup [0, 6]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2; attack = 0.018; release = b; knee = 14; makeup = c

name: Drum Clip Bus
description: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
script:
# Drum Clip Bus
# Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Ceiling [0.45, 0.9]
param c = Top [3500, 8000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.25
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28

name: Mixbus Satin
description: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
script:
# Mixbus Satin
# Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.

param a = Satin [0.4, 1.4]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.2]
param c = Air [0, 2]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.1

name: Hard Clip Club
description: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
script:
# Hard Clip Club
# Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.

param a = Drive [2, 9]
param b = Ceiling [0.28, 0.7]
param c = Top [3000, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.4), b)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32

name: AM Radio Narrow
description: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
script:
# AM Radio Narrow
# Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.

param a = Low [350, 700]
param b = High [2000, 3500]
param c = Bits [6, 11]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.3), c)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28

name: Dialogue Phone
description: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
script:
# Dialogue Phone
# Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.

param a = Low [300, 700]
param b = High [2500, 4200]
param c = Grit [0.5, 2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = diode(x, c)

name: Glitch Hold Gate
description: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
script:
# Glitch Hold Gate
# Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.

param a = Depth [0.5, 1]
param b = Open [-30, -8]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = square; freq = 1/16; depth = 1
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.01; range = -70
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - a + a * (0.05 + 0.95 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))), c)

name: Acoustic Body
description: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.
script:
# Acoustic Body
# Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.

param a = Body [120.0, 600.0]
param b = Res [0.4, 2.2]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 500; resonance = b
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.08
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Arp Shimmer
description: Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.
script:
# Arp Shimmer
# Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.

param a = Sparkle [4000.0, 16000.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 2.5; depth = 1.0
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.6
stage1: y = x + osc1 * 0.03

name: Loudness Safe
description: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.
script:
# Loudness Safe
# Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.

param a = Drive [0.5, 4.0]
param b = Ceiling [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.5
stage1: y = hardclip(tanh(x * a), b)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Tape Wobble
description: Slow pitch/wow flutter.
script:
# Tape Wobble
# Slow pitch/wow flutter.

param a = Wow [0.1, 3.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x + y_prev * 0.12 + osc1 * 0.04
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Telephone EQ
description: Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.
script:
# Telephone EQ
# Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.

param a = LowCut [120.0, 500.0]
param b = HighCut [2500.0, 5000.0]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.0]
param d = Res [0.3, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = d
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = d
stage1: y = tanh(x * c)

name: Vocal Double
description: Subtle detune/double thickness.
script:
# Vocal Double
# Subtle detune/double thickness.

param a = Detune [0.0, 0.4]
param b = DelayFb [0.0, 0.6]
param c = Blend [0.0, 1.0]
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - c) + (x + y_prev * b + a * 0.05) * c
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Broken Grid Chaos
description: Experimental glitch: S&H square LFO drives random filter jumps, stepped bitcrush modulation, feedback-modulated delay, asymmetric fold + gate.
script:
# Broken Grid Chaos
# Experimental glitch: S&H square LFO drives random filter jumps, stepped bitcrush modulation, feedback-modulated delay, asymmetric fold + gate.

param a = Chaos Rate [4.0, 18.0]
param b = Crush Depth [4.0, 10.0]
param c = Fold Asym [0.3, 0.8]
param d = Delay Chaos [0.2, 1.5]
param e = Gate Thresh [-42, -30]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0
osc2: shape = triangle; freq = d; depth = 1.0
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 3000; resonance = 0.85
stage1: y = bitcrush(x, b + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 3)
delay1: time = 80; feedback = 0.4 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc2) * 0.25; mix = 0.35; damp = 5000
stage2: y = fold(x, -0.2 * c, 0.6 * c)
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6800; resonance = 0.32
gate1: threshold = e; hyst = 6; hold = 0.06; range = -18; attack = 0.001; release = 0.06
stage3: y = x * f

name: Germanium Fuzz
description: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).
script:
# Germanium Fuzz
# Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).

param a = Fuzz [3.0, 16.0]
param b = Tone [250, 4500]
param c = Level [0.15, 0.85]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 8; hold = 0.04; range = -80
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 45; resonance = 0.3
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x + 0.06, a * 0.4), 0.38)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.4) * c
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 8
limit1: ceiling = -0.4; release = 0.1

name: Blues Break OD
description: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.
script:
# Blues Break OD
# Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.

param a = Drive [0.2, 5.0]
param b = Tone [400.0, 8000.0]
stage1: y = tanh(x * a + 0.05)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.7

name: Frequency Assassin
description: Industrial smash: three notch filters with inverse LFO sweeps cut 200-1800 Hz, remaining spectrum through fuzz + fold, rhythmic gate.
script:
# Frequency Assassin
# Industrial smash: three notch filters with inverse LFO sweeps cut 200-1800 Hz, remaining spectrum through fuzz + fold, rhythmic gate.

param a = Notch Sweep [0.3, 2.5]
param b = Notch Width [3.0, 4.0]
param c = Fuzz [4.0, 14.0]
param d = Gate Thresh [-42, -24]
param e = Delay FB [0.2, 0.7]
param f = Mix [0.5, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.4
osc1: shape = triangle; freq = a; depth = 1.0
eq1: type = notch; freq = 500 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
eq2: type = notch; freq = 1100 + (0.5 - 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
eq3: type = notch; freq = 1700 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * 400; q = b; gain = 0
stage1: y = tube(x, c * 0.4)
stage2: y = tube(x, c * 0.5)
stage3: y = fold(x, -0.4, 0.5)
gate1: threshold = d; hyst = 6; hold = 0.04; range = -18
delay1: sync = 1/16; feedback = e; mix = 0.22; damp = 5000; pingpong = true
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7200; resonance = 0.35
comp1: threshold = -16; ratio = 6; attack = 0.005; release = 0.1; makeup = 4
stage4: y = x * f

name: Preamp Regen Stack
description: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
script:
# Preamp Regen Stack
# HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.

param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d

name: Cascade Loop Dirt
description: 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.
script:
# Cascade Loop Dirt
# 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.

param a = Drive [1.5, 9.0]
param b = Loop [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Tone [500, 6000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.05]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.45)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.5)
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.35)
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5
stage4: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * d

name: Synth Feedback Lead
description: Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.
script:
# Synth Feedback Lead
# Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.

param a = Drive [1.5, 8.0]
param b = Feed [0.12, 0.52]
param c = Cutoff [600, 7000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.0]
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.45)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.2) * d

name: Boom Tail
description: Sub-safe boom: rumble cut, tube weight, long dark tail. Park on an impact or drone send.
script:
# Boom Tail
# Sub-safe boom: rumble cut, tube weight, long dark tail. Park on an impact or drone send.

param a = Drive [1.3, 4.0]
param b = Size [0.52, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.48, 0.9]
param d = Mix [0.2, 0.68]
param e = Sub [40, 110]
param f = Tone [1800, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.24
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = 0.7; mix = d; width = 0.8
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.26
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.06)

name: Tension Bed
description: Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.
script:
# Tension Bed
# Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.

param a = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
param b = Size [0.4, 0.88]
param c = Mix [0.22, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 0.8]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Tone [2500, 8000]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = d
stage1: y = tube(x, a)
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.62; mix = 1; width = 0.85
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25
stage3: y = lerp(x, softclip(y, 1.06), c)

name: Bitcrush Glitch
description: Digital glitch and bit reduction.
script:
# Bitcrush Glitch
# Digital glitch and bit reduction.

param a = Bits [2.0, 12.0]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = 3000; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = bitcrush(x + osc1 * 0.05, a)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25

name: Dark Atmosphere
description: Low ominous atmosphere layer.
script:
# Dark Atmosphere
# Low ominous atmosphere layer.

param a = Dark [40.0, 300.0]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * 4; resonance = 1.1
stage1: y = x * 0.3 + noise(t * sr) * 0.22 + y_prev * 0.15
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * 12; resonance = 0.25

name: Midtempo Pressure Pump
description: Midtempo 110-130 BPM: triangle LFO (1/8 sync) modulates filter cutoff/reso/drive, asymmetric fold, noise injection, counter-pump sidechain.
script:
# Midtempo Pressure Pump
# Midtempo 110-130 BPM: triangle LFO (1/8 sync) modulates filter cutoff/reso/drive, asymmetric fold, noise injection, counter-pump sidechain.

param a = LFO Rate [1/1, 1/16]
param b = Filter Depth [1000, 4000]
param c = Reso Depth [0.5, 2.5]
param d = Drive Depth [2.0, 5.0]
param e = Noise [0.05, 0.2]
param f = Pump [2.0, 8.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35
osc1: shape = triangle; sync = a; depth = 1.0
stage1: y = x * (1 - e) + x * e * 1.15
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 300 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; resonance = 0.4 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * c
stage2: y = tube(x, 1.5 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * d)
stage3: y = fold(x, -0.35, 0.45)
comp1: threshold = -14; ratio = f; attack = 0.003; release = 0.08; makeup = 4
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.28
limit1: ceiling = -0.3; release = 0.1
